process.heading: Four simple steps to a delicious meal
process.description: You do not need to be a professional chef to create magic in the kitchen. We are here to help!
process.chooseDesc: Choose a dish you like from our catalog and explore its recipe.
process.prepareDesc: Get all the ingredients listed in the recipe ready.
process.cookDesc: Follow each instruction step by step.
process.enjoyDesc: Serve your delicious dish and share it with your loved ones.
process.ctaDesc: Bring a new flavor to your kitchen!
process.tip1Desc: The fresher the ingredients, the tastier the dish. Buy vegetables and meat on the same day whenever possible.
process.tip2Desc: Read the recipe from start to finish and prepare the ingredients in advance, so cooking goes smoothly without rushing.
process.tip3Desc: Many dishes taste best when cooked slowly. Lower the heat once it starts boiling and stir from time to time so nothing burns.
process.tip4Desc: Taste the dish while cooking and adjust the salt and spices at the end, so the flavor is exactly to your liking.
process.faq1A: Most recipes are simple and written step by step. Each dish shows its cooking time and difficulty level.
process.faq2A: Often yes. However, we recommend not replacing the main ingredients (meat, rice, flour), as the taste may change.
process.faq3Q: How do I know the dish is ready?
process.faq3A: Check off each step in the recipe. When all steps are completed, the page lets you know the dish is ready.
